text:
Elena: Escalating GreenGrid trial - onboarding blocked. Customers cannot complete the webhook verification step; platform returns 503 / provisioning_timeout intermittently. Support opened CSUP-54321. Customer says this is impacting their pilot and may delay renewal decision.

Tom: Can you share the error examples and the sequence of events? Is this across regions or a single region?

Elena: Paste from support log: ```503: provisioning_timeout - stage=provision-tenant - duration=45s - tx=0a1b2c - at=2026-03-23T09:10:12Z``` Happens in us-west-2 only, started after they attempted a bulk seat import.

Priya: Traced it to a race in our tenant provisioner when import size > 500 seats. The queue hits a backpressure path and times out. We have a workaround: increase the provisioner timeout + enable async enqueue for that account.

Sam: For immediate relief we can: (1) apply a per-account async enqueue flag, (2) bump provisioner timeout to 90s for sage accounts, (3) move their provision job to a higher-priority queue. Which should I take?

Elena: Do (1) and (3) now, please. We'll coordinate the timeout change after we confirm stability.

Jules: I'll own customer communications. Draft comms: "We're actively mitigating a provisioning race that impacted large imports. We've queued your import to a prioritized background path and you'll receive a progress update in 2 hours. We'll follow up with an enablement session to review bulk import best practices." Thoughts?

Tom: Good. Also flag for renewal health: recommend we set a renewal_watch tag for 60 days and schedule a 1:1 enablement for the CTO level if they remain on the fence. Finance needs to be looped for concession guidance.

Priya: Work started: enabling async enqueue for account=greengrid-001, moving job to high-priority-queue. ETA for visible progress: ~25 mins.

Elena: Customer on ticket: "Thanks, please confirm when imports resume. We're in a demo window tomorrow."

Jules: I'll send immediate note: "Import moved to prioritized queue; monitoring and ETA ~30 mins. We will be on the 10am demo call with you and provide a post-mortem + checklist." Also I'll propose a compensation credit if service disruption persists past 24h.

Sam: Note for ops: temp config applied: async_enqueue=true for greengrid-001, priority_queue=high. Reverted after 48h unless ops says otherwise. Watch metrics: provision_success_rate, queue_backlog.

Priya: Patch to provisioner merged to main (link: https://github.com/redwood/provisioner/commit/def456) that fixes race on large imports. We should schedule a canary deploy to staging then prod.

Tom: Owners and timeline:
- Priya: apply hotfix canary + monitor (ETA 3h)
- Sam: maintain temporary queue flags and roll back after stable (owner until 48h)
- Jules: customer comms + renewal watch tag + schedule enablement call (owner)
- Elena: keep ticket CSUP-54321 updated with traces and confirm demo support tomorrow

Elena: Adding the debug bundle to the ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CSUP-54321. Also tagging finance for concession guidance.

Jules: Customer replied: "We appreciate the quick action. If we can get imports done before the demo, we'll likely proceed with renewal."

Tom: Please record the post-incident enablement plan: 1) run a joint import walkthrough, 2) share bulk import checklist, 3) propose monthly import health report for 90 days. We'll capture feedback and update the docs.

Priya: Canary deploy started. Monitoring traces and queue length. Posting results in channel in 45m.

Sam: I'll update this thread once metrics show import completion.

Jules: Thanks team 44d I'll run the demo call and capture customer sentiment + next steps. Will escalate to CS leadership if renewal risk increases.

Elena: Closing loop here when demo is done. Keeping renewal_watch active for 60 days.
